data.title: Bußgeldbescheid: Speeding fine of €228.50
data.summary: The Zentrale Bußgeldbehörde Mustersaar issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 11 October 2027 against Noemi Musterbecker for driving 34 km/h over the 70 km/h limit on 2 September 2027 near St. Musterwendel, setting a total of €228.50 (fine, administrative fee and delivery costs) plus 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. The notice was delivered on 18 October 2027 via Postzustellungsurkunde.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice for a speeding offense. You may decide whether to accept it or file an objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldbehörde in writing — the app shows the deadline for this. If you don't object by then, the notice becomes final and the €228.50 must be paid within two weeks after that, to the account shown, quoting the file number. Do not pay before the notice is final. The offense also adds 1 point to your driving record at the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt, which you cannot contest separately. If you're unsure whether to object, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsanwalt) before the deadline.
